stations.title: Whiteboard
stations.text: Names crossed out, moved and squeezed in.

captions: A callout at the base, and Rhona phones down the call-out list from the top.
Today the list is a whiteboard of arrows, and she loses her place.
You keep the names in a list, read it by position, and change it in place.
Now the next name is always at the top, and the board is tidy.
Lists, positions, slices, and methods that change a list.
